name: AI Services & Automations
summary: Custom AI tools and workflow automation that answer calls, qualify leads, follow up on jobs, and handle the repetitive work that eats your day — so your team can focus on the jobs that pay.
features: AI voice and chat agents that answer missed calls and website chats 24/7
Automated lead follow-up sequences across text, email, and voicemail drop
Document and data automation — quotes, invoices, job files, and reports generated for you
AI-assisted review requests, appointment reminders, and no-show recovery
Custom GPT-powered tools trained on your business, pricing, and processes

process.title: Audit
process.detail: We map every repetitive task in your sales and operations flow and flag what's costing you the most time.

process.title: Design
process.detail: We design the automation or AI agent around how your business actually runs — not a generic template.

process.title: Build & Connect
process.detail: We wire it into your CRM, phones, and calendar so it works with the tools you already use.

process.title: Tune & Support
process.detail: We monitor performance for the first 60 days and keep tuning it as your business changes.

faq.q: Will an AI agent sound robotic to my customers?
faq.a: No — every voice and chat agent is scripted and trained on your business, your tone, and your services before it ever talks to a real lead. Most callers don't realize they're not talking to a person until you tell them.

faq.q: What if I lose a lead because the AI can't answer something?
faq.a: Every automation we build has a clear handoff path — a live transfer, an instant text alert to your phone, or a booked callback — so nothing falls through a gap.

faq.q: Do I need a CRM already in place?
faq.a: No. We can build the automation layer on top of your existing CRM or set one up for you as part of the project — see CRM Build & Management.

name: CRM Build & Management
tagline: One system for every lead, job, and follow-up.
summary: We build and manage your CRM — pipelines, automations, calendars, and reporting — so leads stop living in text threads and sticky notes and start turning into booked, tracked, repeatable revenue.
features: Full CRM build-out (GoHighLevel and other platforms) tailored to your sales process
Pipeline and job-stage tracking from first inquiry to invoice paid
Automated appointment booking, reminders, and rescheduling
Team inboxes so every call, text, and form fill lands in one place
Done-for-you monthly management, cleanup, and optimization

process.title: Map Your Process
process.detail: We document exactly how a lead becomes a customer today, warts and all.

process.title: Build the Pipeline
process.detail: We configure stages, forms, calendars, and automations to match that process — not a generic template.

process.title: Migrate & Train
process.detail: We move your existing contacts and data in, then train your team on the parts they'll touch daily.

process.title: Manage Month-to-Month
process.detail: We keep it clean, updated, and improving as your business grows — you're never left to figure it out alone.

faq.q: We already have a CRM. Can you just fix it?
faq.a: Yes — a lot of our CRM work is cleanup and rebuild on systems that were set up once and never touched again. We'll audit what you have before recommending a rebuild.

faq.q: Do you only work with GoHighLevel?
faq.a: GoHighLevel is our primary platform because of what it can automate in one place, but we've built and managed CRMs on other platforms too — we'll recommend what fits your business.
No — we offer one-time build-outs and monthly management separately. Most clients start with a build and add management once they see the volume it creates.

name: Custom Tool Building
tagline: Software built around your business, not the other way around.
summary: When off-the-shelf software almost fits but not quite, we build the custom tool, dashboard, or integration that closes the gap — from internal job trackers to client-facing portals.
features: Custom web apps and internal tools built for your exact workflow
Integrations that connect your CRM, payments, scheduling, and reporting into one flow
Client-facing portals — quotes, invoices, job status, and document uploads
Data tools: dashboards, calculators, lookup tools, and reporting built on your numbers
Ongoing hosting, updates, and support once the tool is live

process.title: Scope the Gap
process.detail: We identify exactly what off-the-shelf software isn't doing for you and what a custom build needs to solve.

process.title: Design the Workflow
process.detail: We map the tool around how your team actually works, not a rebuild of software you already have.

process.title: Build & Deploy
process.detail: We build it, test it against real scenarios from your business, and deploy it to a live environment.

process.title: Support & Iterate
process.detail: We keep it running and add features as your business needs change.

faq.q: What kind of tools have you built before?
faq.a: Bank statement underwriting tools, custom field lookup apps, SMS blast platforms, document generators, and internal dashboards — the common thread is software built for one specific business's workflow.

faq.q: How long does a custom build take?
faq.a: Most focused tools take 2-6 weeks depending on scope. We'll give you a clear timeline and milestones before work starts.

faq.q: Do you host and maintain the tool afterward?
faq.a: Yes — we can host it, monitor it, and handle updates, or hand off the code to your own team if you prefer to run it in-house.

name: Web Design
tagline: A website built to be found, and built to convert.
summary: Fast, mobile-first websites designed around the way your customers actually search — with dedicated pages for every service you offer and every town you serve, so you show up for the searches that matter.
features: Custom-designed, mobile-first websites — no drag-and-drop templates
Dedicated service and industry pages instead of one crowded homepage
Local service-area pages built for every town in your coverage zone
Built-in lead capture: forms, click-to-call, and booking widgets
Fast load times and clean code structured for search visibility

process.title: Discovery
process.detail: We learn your services, service area, and what makes you different from the next company in the search results.

process.title: Design
process.detail: We design a site around your brand and your customers — not a recycled template with your logo swapped in.

process.title: Build
process.detail: We build every service, industry, and location page needed to cover how people actually search for you.

process.title: Launch & Grow
process.detail: We launch, connect it to your CRM and tracking, and keep adding pages as your business expands.

faq.q: Do you write the content too?
faq.a: Yes — copywriting for every page is included, built around your actual services and service area rather than generic filler text.

faq.q: Can you rebuild my current site instead of starting over?
faq.a: Yes — a rebuild that keeps what's working and fixes what isn't is often faster and cheaper than starting from a blank page.

faq.q: Will my site include pages for every town I serve?
faq.a: Yes, that's standard on every build — location pages are one of the biggest drivers of local search traffic for service businesses.

name: Digital Marketing
tagline: Ads and SEO that bring in jobs, not just clicks.
summary: Campaign management across Google, Meta, and search — built to fill your calendar with qualified jobs in your service area, tracked back to real revenue, not vanity metrics.
features: Google Ads and Local Service Ads management for service-area businesses
Meta (Facebook & Instagram) campaigns built around your best-performing jobs
Local SEO — Google Business Profile optimization and review growth
Programmatic SEO content and location pages that compound over time
Monthly reporting tied to booked jobs and revenue, not just impressions

process.title: Audit
process.detail: We review your current ad accounts, website, and search visibility to find the fastest wins.

process.title: Build Campaigns
process.detail: We build or rebuild campaigns targeting your actual service area and highest-margin jobs.

process.title: Launch & Track
process.detail: We connect every campaign to your CRM so every lead is tracked from click to closed job.

process.title: Optimize Monthly
process.detail: We report on what's working, cut what isn't, and reinvest in what's bringing in revenue.

faq.q: How fast will I see results?
faq.a: Paid ads can bring leads within days of launch. SEO and programmatic content are longer plays that typically build meaningful traffic over 3-6 months.

faq.q: Do you handle both the ads and the website?
faq.a: Yes — because we also build the sites and CRMs behind the campaigns, we can track a lead from the ad click all the way to the booked job.

faq.q: What's the minimum ad spend to get started?
faq.a: It depends on your market and service area size — we'll recommend a starting budget during the audit based on your local competition.
